content.short: GADA is a community-governed launchpad on Cardano that empowers DeFi projects to raise liquidity and launch tokens.
content.description: GADA is a decentralized, community-driven launchpad designed to accelerate the growth of the Cardano DeFi ecosystem. The platform provides a secure environment for new projects to raise liquidity, distribute tokens, and bootstrap their communities through GADA Light and GADA Pro tiers. By offering a permissionless framework for funding and incubation, GADA helps high-quality initiatives navigate the path from concept to launch. Investors benefit from a curated selection of value-added projects, making GADA a central hub for innovation and capital formation within the Cardano blockchain.
content.meta: GADA is a decentralized Cardano launchpad for project funding, token distribution, and DeFi growth. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
